dialogues.speaker: Quest Test NPC
dialogues.text: In front of you is the danger zone... Huh? Could you possibly be...

response.speaker: Quest Test NPC
response.text: Your attire... Could you be the traveler they spoke of?

response.speaker: Quest Test NPC
response.text: Huh? You don't? Your heroic deeds have already spread across Mondstadt. I heard that it was you who put an end to the storms that terrorized Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Quest Test NPC
response.text: Though I believe you're capable of dealing with the monsters ahead, I'd still like to ask you to watch out and take care.
